newsitem.title: POLAND: Komunalny picks BGK to lead bond issue.
newsitem.headline: Komunalny picks BGK to lead bond issue.

text.p: Poland's Bank Komunalny in the port town of Gdynia picked Bank Gospodarstwa Krajowego SA to lead its planned convertible bond issue, Bank Komunalny said in a statement on Monday.
The bank had earlier said it planned to issue two million convertible bonds of 30 months maturity for which investors may subscribe from May 20 to May 24.
The bonds' minimum price will not be smaller than the average share price of Komunalny from three consecutive bourse sessions four days before the start of the subscription.
The bonds will carry a one zloty coupon, paid after 12 and 24 months from the end of the subscription.
One bond may be exchanged for 0.8 shares from May 25 1998 to November 25, 1998 and for one share from May 25, 1999 to November 25, 1999.
